title: SmartAction: Ibhola lobhasikidi 3×3

keyboardHelp: Sebenzisa W/A/S/D ukuze uhambe nokhiye bemicibisholo ukuze uqondise. Q: gxuma, E: khothama, J: dlulisa; bamba ukhiye K ukuze uqongelele amandla bese uyadedela ukuze ushuthe. Ukhiye Tab ushintsha abadlali.
touchHelp: Hamba ngephedi yokuthinta yesobunxele bese uqondisa ngephedi yesokudla. Sebenzisa izinkinobho zokugxuma, ukukhothama, ukudlulisa nokushutha.
chargeHelp: Bamba inkinobho yokushutha ukuze uqongelele amandla, bese uyidedela ngesikhathi esifanele. Uma useduze nobhasikidi, zama ukufaka ibhola usondele noma idanki.
deviceNote: Ezinye iziphequluli azilivezi lonke ulwazi lwememori noma lwe-CPU. Ukuhlola okufushane kulinganisela ikhwalithi efanele; ungayishintsha ngokwakho.
replayHint: Hudula kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla ukuze uzungezise ikhamera, ubuke okugqamile kuhamba kancane ku-360°.

rule_batting: Hamba W/A/S/D · Ukhalo Z/C · Qondisa ←↑↓→ · Zulisa ibhethi K. Isikhathi sokushaya + ukhalo → ibanga.

rule_basketball5: Ukuzijwayeza abahlanu ngokumelene nabahlanu enkundleni egcwele. Hlasela ubhasikidi okude: amaphuzu angu-2 ngaphakathi komugqa ogobile, angu-3 ngaphandle kwawo; abavikeli bahlasela ngakolunye uhlangothi. Bamba ukhiye K ukuze uqongelele amandla okushutha bese udedela eduze nophawu; J: dlulisa; Q: gxuma; Tab: shintsha umdlali.
rule_field-hockey: Ukuzijwayeza ihokhi ngabadlali abahlanu eqenjini. Gcina ibhola ngasenduku yakho, dlulisa ngokhiye J bese ushutha phansi ngokhiye K usesiyingini sokushutha. Abaphikisi bangalihlwitha ibhola uma beseduze.
rule_water-polo: Ukuzijwayeza echibini ngabadlali abane eqenjini. Abadlali babhukuda kancane, ngakho dlulisa masinyane (J) bese uphonsa egolini elincane ngokhiye K. Bamba inkinobho yokukhothama ukuze ucindezele ophethe ibhola.
rule_softball: Ukuphonsa ngezansi kusuka esiyingini esiseduze, ngebhola elikhulu. Hambisa indawo yebhethi ethinta ibhola uyise lapho ibhola liya khona, bamba ukhiye K bese udedela lapho ibhola lifika epuletini. Ukushaya kuletha amaphuzu okuzijwayeza angu-1–4.
rule_beach-volleyball: Ababili ngokumelene nababili esihlabathini. Ngena ngaphansi kwebhola, dedela ukhiye K ukuze uhlasele ngaphezu kwenethi noma J ukuze uliphakamise kancane. Iphuzu litholakala uma ibhola lithinta isihlabathi ngakolunye uhlangothi.
rule_golf: Qondisa ngephedi yesokudla, bamba ukhiye K ukuze usethe amandla, dedela ukuze uzulise. Imishayo embalwa ukuya embotsheni inikeza amaphuzu amaningi; imbobo ngomshayo owodwa inamaphuzu angu-10. Umoya ubonakala esikrinini.
rule_cricket: Ibhola lomphonsi ligxuma kanye ngaphambi kokuba lifike kuwe. Hambisa ibhethi uyise emugqeni webhola, bamba ukhiye K bese udedela emugqeni womshayi. Amagijimo ngokwebanga, angu-4 uma ibhola lifika emngceleni, angu-6 uma leqa intambo; uma ugeja ibhola bese lishaya izinti, uyaphuma.
rule_sepak-takraw: Ivolibhola yokukhahlela, abathathu ngokumelene nabathathu. Ma ngaphansi kwebhola bese udedela ukhiye K ukuze ulikhahlele ngaphezu kwenethi, noma J ukuze uliphakamise ngokulawula. Ibhola alivumelekile ukuthinta phansi ngasohlangothini lwakho.
rule_squash: Shaya ibhola liye odongeni lwangaphambili ngaphezu kwethini. Libuyise ngaphambi kokuba ligxume okwesibili; umphikisi kumele enze okufanayo. Iphuzu liqeda ukushayana ngakunye.
rule_lacrosse: Ukuzijwayeza ngenduku ngabadlali abahlanu eqenjini. Gcina ibhola enetheni lenduku yakho, dlulisa ngokhiye J bese ushutha ngokhiye K egolini elincane elinenethi. Abavikeli bangashaya induku yophethe ibhola.
rule_bowling: Qondisa ngephedi yesokudla, bamba ukhiye K ukuze usethe ijubane bese udedela. Izinti eziwisiwe ziyabalwa; ukuwisa zonke eziyishumi ngesikhathi esisodwa kuthiwa “zonke ziwile”. Jikisa ibhola ngephedi yesobunxele.
rule_soft-tennis: Ababili ngokumelene nababili ngebhola lenjoloba elithambile eligxuma phezulu futhi kancane. Dedela ukhiye K ukuze ushaye ngamandla, J ukuze uliphakamise ibhola. Ibhola ligxuma kanye ngaphambi kokulibuyisa ngakunye.
rule_billiards: Qondisa ngephedi yesokudla, bamba ukhiye K ukuze uthole amandla bese udedela ukuze ushaye ibhola elimhlophe. Faka amanye amabhola emigodini ukuze uthole amaphuzu; ukufaka ibhola elimhlophe emgodini kuyiphutha.
rule_flag-football: Ibhola lezinyawo elingenakuthintana, abadlali abahlanu eqenjini. Gijima noma udlulise (J) uye endaweni yokugcina; umvikeli okhipha ifulegi lakho uqeda umdlalo. Amaphuzu okuzijwayeza angu-6 ngethachidawuni ngayinye.
